questions.question: Who among the following Rajput rulers defeated Muhammad Ghori in the First Battle of Tarain in 1191 AD?
questions.solution:
• Winner: Prithviraj Chauhan
  • Event: The First Battle of Tarain (1191 AD), where he defeated Muhammad Ghori. Note: Ghori returned in 1192 to win the Second Battle.

questions.question: ______ was an important port city in ancient India.
questions.solution:
• Port City: Tamralipti
  • Context: Located in modern-day West Bengal, it was a major exit point for trade with Southeast Asia and Sri Lanka in ancient times.

questions.question: The British East India Company captured Pondicherry (Puducherry) from the French in the year ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1761
  • History: The British captured Puducherry during the Third Carnatic War, dealing a massive blow to French influence in India.

questions.question: Which of the following was a fishing colony that was used as a port for trading with the Romans and the Greco-Romans in ancient India?
questions.solution:
• Location: Arikamedu
  • Trade: An archaeological site near Puducherry that served as a major Indo-Roman trading station (amphorae and Roman coins were found here).

questions.question: After Mahatma Gandhi’s release from prison in January 1931, Congress leaders met at ______ to plan the future course of action.
questions.solution:
• Meeting Place: Allahabad
  • Context: Following the Gandhi-Irwin Pact and release from prison, leaders gathered here to discuss the suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement.

questions.question: The Atharvaveda is a collection of ______ khandas.
questions.solution:
• Structure: 20 Khandas
  • About: The Atharvaveda is the 'Veda of magical formulas' and contains about 730 hymns and 6,000 mantras.

questions.question: Which two kings fought in the Battle of Hydaspes?
questions.solution:
• Opponents: Alexander and Porus
  • Battle: Fought in 326 BC on the banks of the Jhelum (Hydaspes) River. Alexander won but was impressed by Porus's bravery.

questions.question: Under which of the following rulers did Delhi first became a capital?
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Tomara Rajputs
  • Fact: Under Anangpal Tomar, Delhi (Dhillika) first became a capital in the 12th century before being taken by the Chauhans.

questions.question: Who among the following was a ruler of the Rashtrakuta dynasty?
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Dhruva
  • Dynasty: A powerful Rashtrakuta king who expanded the empire into North India and fought in the Tripartite Struggle.

questions.question: Which of the following Harappan sites is in Haryana?
questions.solution:
• Site: Rakhigarhi
  • Significance: Located in Hisar, Haryana, it is one of the largest settlements of the Indus Valley Civilization.

questions.question: As per the Union Budget of 2021-22, how many textile parks are to be set up in 3 years?
questions.solution:
• Budget 2021-22: Seven
  • Scheme: Known as the MITRA scheme (Mega Investment Textiles Parks) to make the Indian textile industry globally competitive.

questions.question: During the rule of which of the following dynasties did Timur or Tamerlane invade India in 1398 AD?
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Tughlaq Dynasty
  • Context: Timur invaded during the reign of Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughlaq, leading to the eventual fall of the dynasty.

questions.question: Which of the following revolutionaries was arrested by the British as an accused in the Alipore Bomb Conspiracy Case?
questions.solution:
• Revolutionary: Kanailal Dutta
  • Event: He was a member of the Jugantar group and was executed in 1908 in connection with the Alipore Bomb case.

questions.question: In which city of Gujarat will you find the Uparkot Buddhist Caves?
questions.solution:
• City: Junagadh
  • Site: The Uparkot Caves are ancient rock-cut Buddhist monasteries dating back to the 2nd-3rd century AD.

questions.question: What was the age in years of the revolutionary Bhagat Singh when he was hanged till death?
questions.solution:
• Age: 23 years
  • Martyrdom: Bhagat Singh, along with Rajguru and Sukhdev, was hanged on 23 March 1931 for the Lahore Conspiracy Case.

questions.question: What was the first name of the Mughal Emperor Babur?
questions.solution:
• Full Name: Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur
  • Founder: He founded the Mughal Empire in India after winning the Battle of Panipat in 1526.

questions.question: In which of the following sessions of the Indian National Congress did George Yule become the President in 1888?
questions.solution:
• Session: Allahabad Session (1888)
  • Fact: George Yule was the first non-Indian (British) president of the Indian National Congress.

questions.question: In which of the following years was the civil disobedience campaign completely ceased?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1934
  • Context: The Civil Disobedience Movement was formally withdrawn by Mahatma Gandhi in May 1934 due to waning momentum.

questions.question: The Bhaja Caves are located in ______.
questions.solution:
• State: Maharashtra
  • Type: A group of 22 rock-cut Buddhist caves located near Lonavala, dating back to the 2nd century BC.

questions.question: King Lalitaditya Muktapida ruled over ______.
questions.solution:
• Region: Kashmir
  • Legacy: A ruler of the Karkota dynasty; he is famous for building the Martand Sun Temple in Kashmir.

questions.question: Which of the following events occurred first during the Indian National Movement?
questions.solution:
• First Event: Partition of Bengal (1905)
  • Timeline: Partition (1905) > Kheda (1918) > Simon Commission (1928) > Dandi March (1930).

questions.question: Dantidurga, who set up his capital at Malkhed was a ______ ruler.
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Rashtrakuta
  • Fact: Dantidurga performed the 'Hiranya-garbha' ritual to establish his status as a Kshatriya king.

questions.question: In which of the following years did the resolution at the Karachi Session of the Indian National Congress dwell on how Independent India’s Constitution should look?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1931
  • Outcome: This session, presided by Sardar Patel, adopted resolutions on Fundamental Rights and National Economic Programs.

questions.question: Who among the following freedom fighters hoisted the Indian flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai during the Quit India Movement?
questions.solution:
• Leader: Aruna Asaf Ali
  • Context: Known as the 'Heroine of the 1942 Movement' for her bravery during the Quit India Movement.
